info.title: Peekaboot API
info.summary: The traces, logs, failures, routes and metrics Peekaboot holds for this application.
info.description:
Every endpoint answers `GET` only. An optional field is always present, `null` where it has no value. A point in time Peekaboot records is an ISO-8601 string in UTC. `server.currentTime` keeps the JVM's own offset. Epoch milliseconds appear only in the insights endpoints: `epochMs`, `endEpochMs`, `timestamps` and a `datetime` tile's `value`. Any other field ending in `Ms` is a duration in milliseconds.

An endpoint refuses a query parameter it does not take, and any parameter sent more than once, with a `400` problem naming it. Spring Security's `continue` is accepted everywhere.

A value Peekaboot masked reads `******`, the literal `/peekaboot/api/features` names in `maskLiteral`. The real value exists but is not shown.

Where Peekaboot's guard is armed, every endpoint needs HTTP Basic credentials: `peekaboot.security.username`, else the build's artifact id or the application name plus `-admin`, else `peekaboot-admin`, and `peekaboot.security.password`, else the password Peekaboot generated and printed on the start that created it. A `405`, a `406` or an unexpected `500` is the application's own error response.

get.summary: Lists every endpoint with one line on what it is for, and where the OpenAPI document is.

200.description: This document, its server set to where the request reached the API.

get.summary: Says which parts of Peekaboot are on, and the thresholds it raises issues at.
Lists traces newest first, with filters and paging.
get.description: A trace that holds some spans but not its root lists no row of its own; fetch it by id.

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: The bucket to list, any case.

parameters.name: rootActionType
parameters.description: Root action types separated by commas, any case, or `*` alone. Every type except `MAINTENANCE` where absent.

parameters.name: rootOperation
parameters.description: Part of the root span's name, any case.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: The request's route pattern, such as `/persons/{id}`, matched exactly.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The start of the request path, as written.

parameters.name: statusCode
parameters.description: The response status, matched exactly.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: The outcome, any case.

parameters.name: minDurationMs
parameters.description: Lists traces that took at least this long.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: An ISO-8601 instant. Keeps traces whose `summary.startTime` is at or after it. Send the `+` of an offset as `%2B`.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: An ISO-8601 instant, later than `since`. Keeps traces whose `summary.startTime` is before it.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: `FULL` adds each row's `data`, any case.

get.summary: Returns one trace with its summary, spans, logs, queries and HTTP exchange.

parameters.name: traceId
parameters.description: The trace id, 32 hex digits. A response's `Server-Timing: trace;desc="00-<traceId>-<spanId>-<flags>"` header names it.

200.description: The trace. `summary.complete` is `false` while spans are still arriving.

get.summary: Searches captured log lines, inside traces and outside them, newest first.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Lists this level and every one above it, any case.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text the message or stack trace contains, any case, after masking.

parameters.name: logger
parameters.description: The start of the logger's name, as written.

parameters.name: traceId
parameters.description: One trace's lines only.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: An ISO-8601 instant. Keeps lines whose `timestamp` is at or after it. Send the `+` of an offset as `%2B`.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: An ISO-8601 instant, later than `since`. Keeps lines whose `timestamp` is before it.

get.summary: Sums up requests, failures and latency per HTTP route over the traces held now.

200.description: One row per method and route, busiest first.

get.summary: Lists every failure the traces showed, one entry per cause and route, kept past the traces themselves.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: An ISO-8601 instant. Keeps the entries whose `lastSeen` is at or after it.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: A route pattern, such as `/orders/{id}`, matched exactly.

get.summary: Returns the Insights levels, panels and tiles.

404.description: Insights is off (`peekaboot.insights.enabled=false`, or no `MeterRegistry`). The body is the application's own error response.

get.summary: Returns one level's metric history, summarised per series, with the problems the window shows.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: A configured level, `0` for the finest. `/peekaboot/api/insights/config` lists them.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: `FULL` adds `timestamps` and each series' samples, any case.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Series ids separated by commas, such as `cpu.process,heap.used`. Narrows `series`, never `problems`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: An ISO-8601 instant. The window holds the samples taken at or after it.

404.description: Insights is off (`peekaboot.insights.enabled=false`, or no `MeterRegistry`). The body is the application's own error response.

get.summary: Streams live metric samples as Server-Sent Events.

200.description: A `tick` event per level-0 interval, its data an `InsightsTick`, and a `rollup` event when a higher level's interval closes, its data an `InsightsRollup`. A comment heartbeat follows 15 seconds without an event. The server closes the stream after 30 minutes.

404.description: Insights is off (`peekaboot.insights.enabled=false`, or no `MeterRegistry`). The body is the application's own error response.

get.summary: Lists every start and stop of the application, oldest first.

404.description: Lifecycle is off (`peekaboot.lifecycle.enabled=false`). The body is the application's own error response.

get.summary: Lists one entry per run of the application, newest first.

404.description: Lifecycle is off (`peekaboot.lifecycle.enabled=false`). The body is the application's own error response.

get.summary: Returns the environment, configuration, health, loggers, migrations, scheduled tasks and runtime facts.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: A language tag such as `de-DE`, for cron descriptions and the server locale's display name. English where absent.

parameters.name: unmask
parameters.description: `true` shows real values in place of masked ones, only while `peekaboot.unmasking.enabled` is on.

get.summary: Lists every Micrometer meter, grouped by name.

peekabootBasic.description: Peekaboot's own guard, armed on a deployment launch with `peekaboot.enabled=true` or by `peekaboot.security.enabled=true`.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: How many rows a page holds.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: The `next` of an earlier response, sent back as it is with the same filters.

BadRequest.description: A parameter the endpoint does not take, one sent more than once, or a value it cannot read. `parameter` names it.

Unauthorized.description: Peekaboot's guard is armed and the request carries no valid credentials.

NotFound.description: The store does not hold the trace.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The insights stream already has 32 subscribers. Retry later.

ApiProblem.description: An RFC 9457 problem. `type` is always `about:blank` and `title` the status's own phrase.

detail.description: What was wrong with this request.

parameter.description: The request parameter at fault, `null` where no single parameter is.

Features.description: Which parts of Peekaboot are on, and the thresholds it raises issues at.

tracingSpansPossible.description: An OpenTelemetry SDK can feed the store. `false` means no span can ever arrive.

maskLiteral.description: The string a masked value is replaced with.

url.description: The context path and DispatcherServlet prefix, `/` at the root.

ApiIndex.description: Where this document is, and every endpoint it describes.

openapi.description: The path of this document, as a client addresses it.

ApiIndex.Endpoint.description: One endpoint and what it is for.

path.description: The path template as a client addresses it, such as `/peekaboot/api/traces/{traceId}`.

purpose.description: The operation's summary in this document.

TraceListResponse.description: A page of the trace list, newest first.

filteredBucketCounts.description: The traces that match every filter. `null` only when the request filters nothing, as `rootActionType=*` alone does; a request naming no type still filters by the default types.

next.description: The `cursor` for the next page, `null` on the last.

BucketCounts.description: How many traces each bucket holds.

TraceResource.description: A trace's summary, and its data where asked for.

TraceSummary.description: What an agent reads first about a trace.

startTime.description: `null` while no timed span has arrived.

run.description: The `startedAt` of the run that produced the trace.

request.description: `null` when the root is no HTTP request.

cause.description: The first failure to look at, `null` when nothing failed.

subtree.description: Set on a listing row for an async task only.

TraceSummary.Cause.description: The deepest failing span's exception, else the first ERROR log with a stack trace, else a 5xx.

applicationFrame.description: The top stack frame inside the application's packages.

TraceSummary.Hotspot.description: A span by its self time.

TraceSummary.Counts.description: Spans, queries and logs in the trace.

SubtreeView.description: The async task a listing row stands for.

TraceReason.description: Why the trace is in a bucket.

TraceIssue.description: An issue on a span. `REPEATED_QUERY` carries the repeated statement besides.

SpanIssue.description: An issue measured on one span.

RepeatedQueryIssue.description: The same normalised statement run at least the threshold's number of times under one parent span.

statement.description: The statement with its literals replaced by `?`.

TraceDetail.description: A trace's spans, logs, queries and HTTP exchange.

orphans.description: The stored subtrees of an incomplete trace.

selfMs.description: The duration less the time its children covered.

SpanEvent.description: An event recorded on a span.

SpanExceptionInfo.description: The exception a failed span recorded, masked and folded.

StackTraceFolding.Range.description: Lines of `stackTrace`, counted from 0, `endExclusive` not included.

parameters.description: The bound values, one list per execution.

traceId.description: `null` for a line written outside any trace.

HttpExchange.description: The root request and its response.

RouteListResponse.description: Request counts and latency per route over what the All bucket holds now.

RouteStats.IssueCounts.description: Per issue type, how many requests carry at least one.

LogSearchResponse.description: A page of the log search, newest first.

next.description: The `cursor` for the next page, `null` on the last.

ErrorDigestResponse.description: Every failure the traces showed, seen latest first.

ErrorDigestEntry.description: One exception class, route and application frame.

runs.description: The `startedAt` of each run it occurred in, the last ten, oldest first.

InsightsConfigResponse.description: The Insights levels, panels and tiles.

InsightsDataResponse.description: One level's window, summarised per series, with the problems it shows.

endEpochMs.description: When the newest sample was taken, epoch milliseconds, 0 before the level's first sample.

timestamps.description: Epoch milliseconds, shared by every series. `null` with `view=summary`.

SeriesSummary.description: A series over the window. The statistics are `null` when `samples` is 0.

InsightsTick.description: The data of a `tick` event, one level-0 sample of every series.

InsightsRollup.description: The data of the `rollup` event a higher level sends when its interval closes.

LifecycleEventsResponse.description: Every start and stop, oldest first.

LifecycleEventsResponse.Event.description: A start or a stop. A stop carries `type` and `timestamp` only, the rest `null`.

uncleanPrevious.description: On a start, whether the previous run recorded no stop.

LifecycleRunsResponse.description: One entry per run, newest first.

ActuatorInsightsResponse.description: What the Overview, Environment, Config, Loggers, Flyway, Liquibase and Scheduled Tasks tabs show.

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON value, masked as a tree.

build.description: The application's `info.build`, as Actuator reports it.

git.description: `null` where the application's own `git.properties` is missing or names neither branch nor commit, where the host turns Boot's git info contributor off, and before the application has started.

GitInfo.description: The Git facts of the application's own `git.properties`.

MemoryInfo.description: Heap and non-heap use, in bytes.

StorageInfo.description: The disk Actuator's disk-space check reads, in bytes.

HealthInfo.description: Health and every component, composites flattened to `parent/child`.

additionalProperties.description: Any JSON value, masked as a tree.

PropertyGroup.description: A property source, or a `@ConfigurationProperties` prefix.

Property.description: A key and its value as a string, masked.

schedule.description: The cron expression, `null` for a fixed task.

ServerInfo.description: The JVM's clock, zone, locale and encoding.

MetricsInfo.description: Every meter in the registry, grouped by name.
